story.what_it_does: IGI certifies gemstones, mainly diamonds and lab-grown diamonds, by grading them and issuing reports. Almost all revenue comes from certification (Rs. 3,875 million of Rs. 3,980 million in the Sep-26 quarter), and the company reports about 60% EBITDA margins.
story.plans: Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 15% and EBITDA growth of 20%, and in the Jun-26 call said it would keep both. It also expects group EBITDA margin to improve by year end and India standalone margin to stabilise around 70%.
story.moat: The notes describe a large share of the independent diamond certification market, with 50% market share cited in one release and management arguing demand for independent certification is rising. The high margins and operating leverage suggest pricing strength, but the notes also flag competition from established global labs that could pressure prices.

scenarios.story: Lab-grown certification keeps growing quickly, as it did with 35% revenue growth in the Mar-26 quarter and 26% volume growth in the Sep-26 quarter. Growth then runs ahead of the 15% revenue and 20% EBITDA guidance, as the first half of FY27 already did (27% revenue, 34% EBITDA).
signals_to_watch: Quarterly report volume growth versus the 26% seen in Q2 FY27
Whether management raises or beats the FY27 guidance of 15% revenue and 20% EBITDA growth

scenarios.story: Revenue and profit keep growing at a solid double-digit pace, in line with management's guidance, helped by lab-grown demand. Margins stay near 60% but are held back by higher staff and marketing costs and by commission payouts to overseas units.
signals_to_watch: Group EBITDA margin versus the 60.4% to 61.4% seen in the last two quarters
India standalone EBITDA margin versus the roughly 70% outlook (it was 69.5% in Q2 FY27)

scenarios.story: Competition from established global labs and the large retailer's own lab-grown brand, which uses its own certification, could squeeze volumes or prices. Weak natural diamond jewelry demand, hit by high gold and silver prices, could also drag on growth.
signals_to_watch: Natural diamond certification growth, which was only 8% in Q2 FY27 after a 19% fall in Jan-Mar 2026
Average realized price per report, which was INR 891 in Q2 FY27 and fell 12% from the prior quarter on lower lab-grown mix
